_purpose: The held primary documents in text, straight from the evidence folders: nothing is copied into kb/. A corpus sync takes each file's blob at `ref`, so the KB is exactly what the collection holds at that commit. HTML and PDF are skipped by the sync and reach readers through the site and the repository instead. publish_tier P: the CLI runs its deny lint before any walk and fails the sync on a hit; every source carries a doc_class (proposed here; the author decides). Every primary-source carries the license basis stated in Copyright_Fairuse_Memo.md.
